endpoint: Any topic/intent/severity exact mismatch or absolute sentiment difference >.25. Excludes entities, needs_review, language from this composite; per-field severity ±1 and sentiment sign shown separately.
procedure: Core-only 35-pair grid. Confidence=min four core fields; margin=min three core Choices. 1000 unique-text bootstrap draws, fixed seed spotify-v3-transfer-calibration-v1. Material: >=25/group, lower pointwise 95% difference >5pp and ratio>=1.5 for both Jev and final comparisons. Exploratory, intervals not multiplicity adjusted; verifier comparisons are not human accuracy.

luna_final_flag_without_jev_trigger.note: Opaque Luna judgment has no separate reason field. These rows are also in frozen initial-unflagged; compare to other initial-unflagged rows to avoid overlap.

proposed_policy.rule: For every final record: original Jev language != english OR missing_context >= .5 OR core confidence/margin below chosen values. Fallback no longer clears these required/core flags.
optional_auxiliary_reasons_dropped: unexplained Luna needs_review has no independent reason; it is not a separate proposed trigger
proposed_policy.selection_reason: Retain the predeclared 0.60/0 if it materially separates both Jev and final disagreement; no target flag rate and no unnecessary post-hoc retuning. Otherwise use strongest qualifying exploratory split.
proposed_policy.migration: Preserve old records/calls/hash. Offline derived flags cost zero, but do not silently rehash completed records: matching succeeded enrich evidence is required. Under current strict cache/export policy, a new final policy/hash requires separately approved fresh enrichment of 3000 v3 texts; v2 pilot/checkpoint remain historical.
